your_company.name: Acme Notes
your_company.text: Acme Notes — team note-taking app. $8/user/month. Features: real-time collaboration, AI summaries, SSO on the top tier. For mid-size product teams.

competitors.name: NoteRival
competitors.text: NoteRival — 'The workspace for fast teams.' Pricing starts at $12/seat/month billed annually. Includes real-time editing, templates, and 24/7 onboarding support. Aimed at enterprise teams.

competitors.name: Competitor B
competitors.text: I think they're cheaper but don't do onboarding support.
